transform: The SVG master was rendered to a 1024 px PNG, scaled to the ten standard macOS icon sizes with sips, and packed with iconutil. caddi-icon-512.png is the 512 px size, used for the Dock icon in source runs.
construction: Original three-path Caddi clubs-and-cuff mark in white on a near-black rounded-square plate, with a top highlight, a light rim and a soft shadow drawn as SVG gradients and filters. No font, photograph or third-party artwork.
identityApproval: Compact Caddi mark direction accepted by the owner on 2026-10-24. Dark plate with white mark requested by the owner on 2026-11-16.
scope: Unsigned local Caddi Development package and source runs. Distribution signing remains separate. Bundle, profile, IPC and credential identifiers are unchanged.

installer.transform: The SVG was rendered with sips at 660 by 420 and 1320 by 840 pixels. scripts/make-dmg.mjs joins the two into one background.tiff with tiffutil when it builds the disk image.
installer.construction: Original artwork drawn as SVG gradients, one drop shadow and two lines of text set in the system font: a near-black plate with a top highlight, a light tray for the two icons, and an arrow. No photograph or third-party artwork.
installer.scope: Background of the Caddi installer disk image window. The in-app welcome uses a copy of caddi-icon.svg at src/caddi/desktop/ui/brand/caddi-icon.svg.
